summary: The pre-sign worker reads free disk from EVIDENCE_PRESIGN_FREE_GIB when it is set, and its tests and the queue signer's set it, so a host with less than 136 GiB free stops failing them under load

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Unset in every service, so production still reads the real disk. Only the tests set the stand-in, as they already do for memory and IO pressure.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes required.
